title: Average monthly revenue
prompt: Using the sales16 table (one row per daily sale, with a month column), first compute the total revenue for each month, then return the average of those monthly totals as a single column named avg_monthly_revenue.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE sales16 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, month TEXT, revenue INTEGER); INSERT INTO sales16 VALUES (1,'Jan',100),(2,'Jan',150),(3,'Feb',200),(4,'Feb',100),(5,'Feb',100),(6,'Mar',500);
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(month_total) AS avg_monthly_revenue FROM (SELECT month, SUM(revenue) AS month_total FROM sales16 GROUP BY month) t;
